name: Kubernetes Pentest
content:
Test the Kubernetes cluster in namespace {namespace:default}.

**Enumeration :**
```bash
# Current context
kubectl config current-context

# Namespaces
kubectl get namespaces

# Pods and services
kubectl get pods -n {namespace:default}
kubectl get services -n {namespace:default}

# Secrets
kubectl get secrets -n {namespace:default}
kubectl get secret SECRET_NAME -o jsonpath='{.data}' | base64 -d
```

**RBAC :**
```bash
kubectl auth can-i --list
kubectl get clusterrolebindings
kubectl get rolebindings -n {namespace:default}
```

**From a compromised pod :**
```bash
# Service account token
cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token

# API access
curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)" \
  https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/{namespace:default}/pods
```

Tools : kube-hunter, kubescape, peirates
